qe: In 1759-61, while the Nawab and the English Company were facing troubles, which Mughal prince invading Bihar and Bengal did the Dutch traders try to co-operate with?
qh: 1759-61 में जब नवाब तथा अंग्रेज कंपनी मुश्किल में थे, बंगाल तथा बिहार के डच किस मुगल शहज़ादे के साथ मिलकर चलने की कोशिश कर रहे थे, जो बिहार और बंगाल पर आक्रमण कर रहा था?
e: Bedara (1759) ki haar ke baad Dutch ki sthiti bahut kamzor ho gayi thi, isliye unhone Bangal tatha Bihar ke un sabhi logon se milkar apni khoyi hui izzat tatha vyapar wapas paane ki koshish ki, jo Nawab ki sarkar se khush nahi the. 1759 se 1761 ke beech kshetra me bahut ashanti thi: Kamgar Khan Main, jo Gaya jile ke Narhat ke zamindar the, Birbhum-Burdwan tatha Vishnupur ke raja tatha Purnea ke gavarnar Khadim Husain Khan Nawab ki sarkar ke viruddh the; Maratha sardaar Sheo Bhat Sathe pashchimi Bangal me lootpat kar raha tha tatha Mughal shehzada Shah Alam II (Ali Gohur) Bihar tatha Bangal par hamla kar raha tha. Dutch log in asantusht logon tatha us shehzade ke saath mil kar chalne lage, kyunki woh apni purani shakti tatha vyapar wapas chahte the. Mir Jafar ne Dutch par ilzaam lagaya ki woh uske khule dushmanon se gupt patra-vyavahar kar rahe the tatha Shah Alam II ki madad ka vada kar chuke the. Exam point: 1759-61 me Dutch ne Mughal shehzada Shah Alam II (Ali Gohur) ke saath milne ki koshish ki; unpar Mir Jafar ne gupt patra-vyavahar tatha madad ka ilzaam lagaya; us daur me Kamgar Khan Main, Khadim Husain Khan tatha Maratha Sheo Bhat Sathe jaise log bhi Nawab ke viruddh the.

qe: Which naib nazim of Bihar wrote to the Dutch, praising their bravery and capacity and promising that whatever they represented to the Emperor would be granted?
qh: बिहार के किस नायब नाज़िम ने डचों को पत्र लिखकर उनकी बहादुरी तथा योग्यता की प्रशंसा की तथा भरोसा दिया कि बादशाह के सामने रखी उनकी हर बात मान ली जाएगी?
e: Bedara ki haar ke baad Dutch log Bangal tatha Bihar ke asantusht logon ke saath milkar apni khoyi hui sthiti sudharne ki koshish kar rahe the. Isi silsile me Bihar ke naib nazim Rajah Ramnarain ne Dutch ko khat likha, jisme unki bahaduri tatha yogyata ki tareef ki gayi tatha kaha gaya ki jo kuch woh Mughal badshah ke saamne rakhenge, woh unhe mil jaayega; unke khat me Meer Said Ali Khan Bahadur ka bhi zikr tha, jo badshah ke darbar me the tatha Ramnarain ke mitra the. Isi tarah Shah Alam II ne bhi Dutch ko likha ki unki wafadari tatha sevaon ka zikr darbar me kiya gaya hai tatha unhe raja ki aagya maan leni chahiye. Ramnarain Bihar ke bahut prabhavshali adhikari the; aage 1763 me Mir Kasim ne unhe marwaya, jis se yeh bhi pata chalta hai ki us daur me naib nazim ki bhumika kitni mahatvapurn thi. Exam point: Bihar ke naib nazim Rajah Ramnarain ne 1759-60 ke aas-paas Dutch ko khat likh kar unki tareef ki tatha badshah se unki madad ka bharosa diya; Shah Alam II ne bhi Dutch ko isi tarah ka khat bheja; aage Mir Kasim ne Ramnarain ko marwaya.

qe: On 11 February 1760, the Nawab of Bengal sent a large army against the Dutch at Hugli under the command of which officer?
qh: 11 फरवरी 1760 को बंगाल के नवाब ने हुगली में डचों के विरुद्ध किस अफसर के नेतृत्व में बड़ी सेना भेजी?
e: Mir Jafar ne Dutch par ilzaam lagaya ki woh uske khule dushmanon se gupt sambandh rakh rahe the tatha Mughal shehzade Ali Gohur (Shah Alam II) ko madad dene ka vada kar chuke the. In aaropon ke kaaran 11 February 1760 ko Nawab ne Kasim Khan ki aguvai me ek badi sena Hugli me Dutch ke paas bheji. Kasim Khan ki sena ne Dutch Company ke kila Fort Gustavus ko is tarah gher liya ki company ke karmcharion ko khana-peena bhi nahi pahunch paaya. Usne kila ke bahari morche yaani outworks girane ka hukm diya tatha Dutch se bhaari jurmana maanga; Dutch ne khud ko nirdosh bataya, lekin unki baat nahi maani gayi tatha unhe bahari morche gira kar bhaari rakam deni padi. Is ghatna se pata chalta hai ki Bedara ke baad Dutch itne kamzor ho gaye the ki Nawab ki marzi ke bina unka ek kila bhi surakshit nahi tha. Exam point: 11 February 1760 ko Nawab Mir Jafar ne Kasim Khan ke netritva me Hugli me Dutch par sena bheji; Dutch ka kila Fort Gustavus gher liya gaya tatha unhe kila ke bahari morche girane pade; Bedara ke baad Dutch ki sthiti bahut kamzor thi.

qe: After the outworks of the Dutch fort at Hugli were razed in February 1760, how much did the Dutch pay to buy off further acts of violence?
qh: फरवरी 1760 में हुगली के डच किले के बाहरी मोर्चे गिराए जाने के बाद डचों ने आगे की हिंसा से बचने के लिए कितनी रकम दी?
e: Mir Jafar ne Dutch par ilzaam lagaya tha ki woh uske dushmanon se mil kar chal rahe the, isliye 11 February 1760 ko Kasim Khan ki aguvai me ek badi sena Hugli me Dutch ke kila Fort Gustavus par bheji gayi. Kasim Khan ne kila ke bahari morche yaani outworks girane ka hukm diya tatha Dutch se bhaari jurmana maanga. Dutch ne khud ko nirdosh batane ki bahut koshish ki, lekin unki baat nahi maani gayi; unhe kila ke bahari hisse poore gira dene pade tatha aage ki hinsa se bachne ke liye pachas hazaar florin dene pade. Florin Holland ki mudra thi, isliye yah rakam us daur ke hisaab se bahut bhaari thi; lekin Dutch ki sthiti itni kamzor ho gayi thi ki unhe yah shart maan kar apna kaam bachana pada. Exam point: February 1760 me Hugli ke Dutch kila Fort Gustavus par Kasim Khan ke hamle ke baad Dutch ne pachas hazaar florin de kar aage ki hinsa se khud ko bachaya; unhe kila ke bahari morche girane pade the; florin Holland ki mudra thi.

qe: In April 1760, accusing the Dutch of levying men, the Nawab demanded from the Company how much gold, threatening to level their settlements if it was not paid?
qh: अप्रैल 1760 में डचों पर सैनिक भर्ती करने का आरोप लगाकर नवाब ने कंपनी से कितना सोना माँगा तथा न देने पर उनकी बस्तियाँ ज़मीन से बराबर कर देने की धमकी दी?
oe: Twenty-two and a half tons of gold
Seven and a half tons of gold
e: April 1760 me Nawab Mir Jafar ne Dutch par ilzaam lagaya ki woh apni company ke liye logon ko sipahi ke roop me bharti kar rahe hain. Usne Cassimbazar factory ke chief ko talab kiya, lekin woh bimaari ke kaaran nahi aa sake, isliye factory ke second adhikari De Wilde Nawab ke saamne pesh hue. Nawab ne unke saamne phir wahi ilzaam dohraya ki company ke karmchari uske dushmanon se patra-vyavahar tatha saazish kar rahe hain, tatha company se bayees-ton-se-adhi yaani two and twenty tons and a half sona maanga; saath hi dhamki di ki agar yah rakam turant na di gayi, to unki poori basti zameen se baraabar kar di jaaegi. De Wilde ne samjhaya ki company ke sipahi Maratha hamlon se bachav ke liye rakhe gaye the, lekin unki baat nahi maani gayi; Nawab ne unhe giraftar kar liya tatha Cassimbazar factory ke saamne gyarah top khadi kar di. Ant me Dutch ne apni factory ko turant tabahi se bachane ke liye saade saat ton sona diya tatha sipahiyon ko hata dene ka vada kiya. Exam point: April 1760 me Nawab Mir Jafar ne Dutch company se bayees-ton-se-adhi sona (two and twenty tons and a half) maanga tatha bastiyan zameen se baraabar karne ki dhamki di; De Wilde giraftar hue tatha Cassimbazar factory ke saamne gyarah top khadi gayi; ant me Dutch ne saade saat ton sona diya.

qe: The second officer of the Dutch factory at Cassimbazar, De Wilde, was put under arrest in April 1760 on the orders of which Nawab of Bengal?
qh: कासिमबाजार की डच फैक्ट्री के दूसरे अफसर डी वाइल्ड को अप्रैल 1760 में बंगाल के किस नवाब के आदेश पर गिरफ्तार किया गया?
e: 1759 ki Bedara ladai ke baad Dutch ki halat bahut kamzor thi tatha woh angrejon tatha Nawab par nirbhar ho gaye the. 1760 me Nawab Mir Jafar unhe baar-baar dosh deta raha ki woh uske dushmanon tatha Mughal shehzade Shah Alam II ke saath mil kar chal rahe hain. April 1760 me Nawab ne Cassimbazar factory ke chief ko bulaya, lekin bimaari ke kaaran woh pesh nahi ho sake, isliye factory ke second adhikari De Wilde ko Nawab ke saamne jaana pada. Nawab ne De Wilde ke saamne ilzaam laga kar unhe giraftar kar liya tatha Dutch company ki Cassimbazar factory ko apni sena se gher kar uske saamne gyarah top khadi kar di. Us samay Bangal ka Nawab Mir Jafar tha, jise angrejon ne Plassey (1757) ke baad gaddi par baithaya tha; Mir Kasim 1760 ke ant me Nawab bana tatha Alivardi Khan us se pehle ke daur ke Nawab the. Exam point: Cassimbazar factory ke second adhikari De Wilde ko April 1760 me Nawab Mir Jafar ne giraftar kiya; factory ko gher kar gyarah top khadi gayi; De Wilde apne chief ke bimar hone ke kaaran pesh hue the.

qe: Among those hostile to the Nawab's government in 1759-61, Khadim Husain Khan was the governor of which district?
qh: 1759-61 में नवाब की सरकार के विरोधियों में शामिल खादिम हुसैन खान किस जिले के गवर्नर थे?
e: Bedara (1759) ke baad Dutch log Bangal tatha Bihar ke un sabhi logon se madad lene ki koshish kar rahe the, jo Nawab ki sarkar se khush nahi the. Un dino Kamgar Khan Main, jo Gaya jile ke Narhat ke zamindar the, Birbhum, Burdwan tatha Vishnupur ke raja tatha Purnea ke gavarnar Khadim Husain Khan Nawab ki sarkar ke viruddh the; isi tarah pashchimi Bangal me Maratha sardaar Sheo Bhat Sathe bhi lootpat kar raha tha. Dutch ne in sabhi asantusht logon tatha Mughal shehzade Shah Alam II ke saath milkar phir se apni izzat tatha vyapar paane ki koshish ki. Isi daur me Nawab tatha angreji Company ko bhi andaruni tatha bahari dono taraf se chunautiyan mil rahi thi, isliye unke dushmanon ko madad dene wale kisi bhi giroh se unhe khatra tha. Exam point: 1759-61 me Nawab ki sarkar ke viruddh khade logon me Purnea ke gavarnar Khadim Husain Khan, Gaya kshetra ke Narhat ke Kamgar Khan Main tatha Birbhum-Burdwan-Vishnupur ke raja shaamil the; Dutch ne in sabse milne ki koshish ki.

qe: Which Dutch fort at Hugli was invested in February 1760 so closely that the Company's servants could get no provisions of any kind?
qh: हुगली का कौन-सा डच किला फरवरी 1760 में इस तरह घेर लिया गया कि कंपनी के कर्मचारियों को किसी भी तरह का खाना-पानी नहीं मिल पाया?
e: Hugli kshetra me Dutch yaani Holland ki East India Company ka ek kila tha, jiska naam Fort Gustavus tha. 1760 me Nawab Mir Jafar ne Dutch par ilzaam lagaya ki woh uske dushmanon se mil kar chal rahe hain tatha unki madad kar rahe hain; isliye 11 February 1760 ko Kasim Khan ki aguvai me ek badi sena us kila par bheji gayi. Kasim Khan ki sena ne kila ko is tarah gher liya ki company ke karmcharion ko khana-peena bhi nahi pahunch paaya tatha usne kila ke bahari morche girane ka hukm diya. Aisi ghatnaon se pata chalta hai ki Bedara ki ladai ke baad Dutch ki rajnitik tatha sainya sthiti kitni kamzor ho gayi thi, kyunki ab woh apne kile tatha vyapar ki raksha khud nahi kar paate the tatha unhe Nawab tatha angrejon ki marzi maanni padti thi. Angrejon ke anya kile Fort William tatha Fort St George alag-alag shahron me hain. Exam point: Hugli me Dutch kila Fort Gustavus tha, jise 11 February 1760 me Kasim Khan ki sena ne gher liya tatha company ke karmchari bina khane-peene ke reh gaye; isse pata chalta hai ki Bedara ke baad Dutch ki sthiti bahut kamzor ho gayi thi.
